title: Load and check a workspace
description: How `lathe check` carries out the Agent's check after a write: it opens the store, which loads the product's data files and Lathe's check rows into a fresh in-memory DuckDB database in one transaction, fills the file facts, runs every check row, reads coverage from the views, and reports. Nothing is written to disk, so there is nothing to commit and nothing to lock.
notes:
## Failure

| What fails | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| A data file breaks the schema. | The store refuses the load: each refusal is a `data-refused` error naming the file, the line and the rule, and nothing else is checked. |
| A check's query fails. | It becomes an error under the check's name, saying why it could not run, and the other checks still run. |
| `lathe.config.json` has a key other than `data`. | The load stops with a message naming the setting. |

## Signals

| Signal | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Exit status 1 | At least one error, data the store refuses included. |
| Exit status 0 | No errors; warnings do not change it. |
